mechanics.rule: Market module endpoints require no authentication; read main index only, not whole API corpus.
symbol or comma-separated symbols query; weightIP25, symbol identity and online/pause/offline/API side permission fields.
baseSizePrecision min quantity; quoteAmountPrecisionMarket min MARKET amount; maxQuoteAmountMarket cap. Decimal precision is not proof of a lot or price increment.
makerCommission/takerCommission appear in public response, no owner-specific/asset/tier settlement proof.
Published LIMIT buy orderPrice<=lastPrice*(1+bidMultiplierUp), sell>=lastPrice*(1-askMultiplierDown). Not adopted as a MARKET rule or Binance-style multiplier.
GET /api/v3/depth symbol/limit default100 max5000,weightIP3; price/quantity pairs and lastUpdateId, no source quote timestamp. Crossed bid15/ask14 toy response is invalid input.
All received enum main content read; MARKET/order/status types contextual, withdrawal/deposit enums not account API access or new strategies.
Official Java serialization example uses System.currentTimeMillis for shared sendTime. Example-level ms evidence, not deployed quote-clock guarantee.
Official protocol docs hyperlink mexcdevelop/websocket-proto; link provenance closes, tree/commit/deployment identity distinct.
fromVersion/toVersion cache+RESTsnapshot algorithm applies aggregate depth, not303limit-depth. Overlap/bootstrap/reinit/zero-delete ambiguities retained.
Official aggregate warning: unmodified levels outside5000snapshot may remain absent. No full-depth/executable-fill certification.
